paragraphs.text: Naka is a Lahu village in the north of [Mengsong](menghai-county:mengsong-naka), near Huazhu Liangzi, the highest peak in Xishuangbanna. Mengsong itself is a township on the east side of Menghai County, facing Nannuo across the Liusha River.

The leaf for this cake was made into [ripe pu’er](shou:definition). It was wetted and heaped in a [warm pile](shou:wet-piling), where heat, moisture and microbes work on it, then dried and pressed into a cake. Yunnan’s state factories brought the method into production in 1973. It makes a tea that is ready to drink soon after it is made, without the years of aging a raw pu’er usually gets.

brewing.text: Ease a piece off the cake along its edge with a pick rather than snapping it. Use boiling water, about 7 grams to 100 ml, one quick rinse, then short steeps that lengthen as the leaf opens. Ripe pu’er forgives a heavy hand and gives eight or more good cups.
